Ember Glaive
Weapon (glaive), very rare (requires attunement)
You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit with it, the target takes an extra 1d6 fire damage.

Infernal Charges. The glaive has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 charge to cast wall of fire (save DC 15) from it.

Burning Riposte. When a creature within your reach hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to make one melee attack with this weapon against that creature.
Proficiency
Glaive
Weight
6 lb.
Cost
--
